_comment: Declarations whose contract this project needs from the tvOS SDK, for code
we write ourselves (Phase 6 cursor, Phase 7 logging). Roblox does not import
these, so they are absent from sdk_query.json and would never be recorded by
the import-driven pass. CLAUDE.md Phase 6 says the exact mechanism for keeping
the focus engine off the remote must be verified in headers, not assumed.

targets.why: Siri Remote as a micro gamepad: which profile the remote reports.
Clickpad as d-pad, and whether values are absolute or relative.
Documented way to stop UIKit's focus engine consuming remote input.
The property that hands remote input to the app instead of the focus engine.
Discovery, connect/disconnect notifications, controllers list.
Axis values for cursor movement.
Detecting that a real game controller is in use, to hide the cursor.
Controller lifecycle notifications.
Play/Pause and Menu presses arrive as UIPress on tvOS; needed for the cursor toggle.
Click to tap, preference 1: dispatch a UIControl's actions directly.
Finding the view under the cursor.
Overlaying the cursor above the key window; tvOS window/scene shape.
Click to tap, preference 2: delivering touches to the engine's render view.
What the focus engine expects, to confirm the cursor overlay does not fight it.
Whether tvOS offers any pointer concept we should use instead of a custom cursor.
Lifecycle hooks for installing the overlay at the right moment.
Phase 1 risk: whether tvOS Metal accepts Roblox's iOS-compiled metallib blobs.
A15 GPU family on Apple TV 4K vs the iPhone Roblox's shaders target.
Phase 1 open question: whether tvOS honours UILaunchStoryboardName.
Phase 2.5 storage: which container directories tvOS declares at all.
